officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: District Morbi, Government of Gujarat; district land-records/e-Dhara information
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official page says the statewide cadastral survey was completed in 1960, land records are updated through computerized applications at each taluka e-Dhara centre, and computerized RoR/mutation services are available through the Mamlatdar office. It links to AnyRoR and lists VF7, VF8A and VF6 record types. No geometry or API was exposed in the page inspected.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Morbi district land-record custody and Gujarat state land-record procedures are evidenced; no anonymous citywide parcel geometry scope is verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if publicly exposed
blocker: No safe anonymous Morbi parcel response containing a native stable ID and geometry was verified. The official district pages provide custodian/procedure evidence; AnyRoR and e-Milkat timed out; national pages are not Morbi parcel APIs.
remainingUncertainty: The official e-Dhara/AnyRoR and city-survey workflows may expose record data interactively or behind CAPTCHA/session steps, and DILRMP/Naksha programme material may have additional map coverage. These were not treated as open machine-readable parcel geometry, and no exact-point hit or miss was used as a citywide conclusion.
nextStep: Retry the official Gujarat land-record services when available and inspect only public geometry-plus-ID responses; separately verify any Morbi-specific NAKSHA or cadastral map service without authentication or unsafe fields.
